pages.text: Iron Ingot is the standard name used by the inventory. The exact identifier is minecraft:iron_ingot.$(br2)A clean iron ingot can be traded, smelted into a tool, or stored with the expedition supplies.

Redstone Dust carries a signal through a circuit. Search the readable name Redstone Dust or the identifier minecraft:redstone to find this note.$(br2)A redstone torch can invert a signal, while a lever provides a simple manual switch.

The emerald is a green trade token found in many village ledgers. Its identifier, minecraft:emerald, is included here as another full-ID prose match. Keep item names in sentences to test natural text lookup.
